verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS fraud-protection service, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only proprietary REST API docs, a downloadable OpenAPI spec and mobile SDKs, with no license stated. An API spec or SDK distribution is not the product's source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
